title: Settings
snapshotHint: Changes only affect new quotes; existing ones keep their snapshot.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.newRequired: New password must be at least 8 characters

userPreferences.title: Language & format
userPreferences.languageCaption: Language the app is shown in.
userPreferences.timeFormatCaption: How times are shown across the app. E.g. 2:30 pm or 14:30.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.caption: Devices that are currently signed in to your account.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.sortableCaption: Allows reordering {{items}}, sections and items by dragging. When off, the order stays fixed.

quoteBuilder.title: Quote builder
quoteBuilder.allowSelectOptionsAtQuoteCaption: Lets you choose item options while creating the quote. When off, this choice is deferred to the event. (Existing quotes don't change.)

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.hideStaleQuotesCaption: Adds an option in the Quotes view so each user can hide the ones that already expired.

taxRates.title: Taxes
taxRates.defaultRateCaption: Copied to each new product and editable on the product. Changing it does not change existing products or lines that were already quoted.

quotePdfTemplate.title: PDF template
quotePdfTemplate.caption: Fixed text printed on the PDF of every generated quote.
quotePdfTemplate.servicesCaption: Printed as "{{Item}}: Duration" under the "SERVICE DURATION" section of the PDF.
quotePdfTemplate.serviceDurationPlaceholder: E.g. Up to 2 hours of service

removeServiceConfirm.title: Remove this service?
removeServiceConfirm.content: It will be removed from the PDF's service duration list.

quotePdfTemplate.termsAndConditionsCaption: Printed as a bullet list in the PDF; leave this empty to skip that section. Click a term to edit it.

removeTermConfirm.title: Remove this term?
removeTermConfirm.content: It will be removed from the PDF's terms and conditions.

quotePdfTemplate.validityNoteCaption: Shown next to the totals in the PDF (e.g. "Prices are valid for...").

removeValidityNoteConfirm.title: Remove the validity note?
removeValidityNoteConfirm.content: It will no longer be printed on the PDF.

quotePdfTemplate.dietaryNoteCaption: Shown at the bottom of the "Services Included" page (only if the quote has items with details).

removeDietaryNoteConfirm.title: Remove the dietary note?
removeDietaryNoteConfirm.content: It will no longer be printed on the PDF.

quoteDefaults.title: Quotes
quoteDefaults.depositRateCaption: Percentage of the total charged as a deposit when a quote is confirmed.
quoteDefaults.quoteValidityMonthsCaption: How many months a quote stays valid before it expires.
quoteDefaults.quoteSeqStartCaption: Number the next quote sequence will start from.
quoteDefaults.currencyCaption: Currency used to display quote amounts.
quoteDefaults.optionsSelectionDeadlineDaysCaption: Days before the event date by which the client's option choices should be confirmed.

permissions.title: My permissions
permissions.description: What your role lets you do in this organization. To change it, ask whoever manages roles.

about.title: About
about.description: Quote, event, and client management system
